item.title: Natsuzora Asterism
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Natsukon
  • 発売日: 2023-09-29
  • スコア: 6.959999999999999/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏空あすてりずむ
  • 英語名: Natsuzora Asterism

あらすじ

[i]I wanted to feel yet more closely,

the shine of those stars that seem within arm’s reach.[/i]

Beneath this sky unfolds an ordinary girls’ summer.

An ordinary summer spent by ordinary girls,

who live in an ordinary town and attend an ordinary school,

walking there down the usual road, at the usual pace, surrounded by the usual smiles.

item.description:

  • ブランド: Natsukon
  • 発売日: 2012-12-31
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 背徳せんせーしょん
  • 英語名: Haitoku Sensation

别名

  • Immoral Sensation

あらすじ

Senpai x Kouhai!! Teacher x Teacher!! Girl x Girl (?)!!

The sensation of immoral couples on a certain campus.

Marika Shirai was a pervert teacher always on the edge of crossing over the cool line.

Hana Nishikigi was a math teacher who felt like something was missing in life.

School isn’t everything! Studying isn’t just about classroom busywork!
